Instruction total count when thread enabled
Tips: this counter represents the actual number of instructions executed by each thread. To aviod overflow, the counter is divided by 16 when counting. Go to compare with InstTotal. If the ratio between the two is too small, it may be that there are too many branches or the utilization rate of the shader group is too low. Specifically the utilization rate of shader group can be obtained from ProbeCount_WdVsThread/ProbeCount_WdVsGroup. If the ratio is less than 64, it indicates that some shader groups are not fully occupied. You can try to adjust each shader group appropriately to become bigger.
